capabilities: Display a random quote or reminder on the new tab page
Maintain a collection file of items separated by blank lines
Change which collection file is used in settings
extras: Not yet on the community plugin list; must be installed manually by unzipping a release into .obsidian/plugins.
problem: Obsidian's new tab page is blank and offers no built-in way to surface a random note, quote, or personal reminder on opening it.
summary: New-tab widget that displays a random note, quote, or reminder from a collection file each time a tab opens.
